comparison.objective: Kit parts from bins selected by illuminated pick indicators, rather than finish HELICOIL inserts.
comparison.physical_skill: Indicator-conditioned bin selection, picking, and sorting versus coaxial tool alignment, hammering, and fragment retrieval.
comparison.success_condition: Title implies only parts from lit bins are correctly kitted; no detailed rubric or quantities are available. Tang fracture and containment are absent.
comparison.reason: The task tests visually cued selection and kitting, not impact-based insert finishing.
